notes: Assumptions that change the number: 16 slices × 40 g (a 700 g SA loaf), so a serving is two jaffles; butter (not margarine) at 14 g per tbsp; mince 15 % fat with nothing drained; 1 cup grated cheddar ≈ 100 g. Sanity check: no published mince-jaffle figure was found; a ham, cheese and tomato jaffle (Jenny Craig, FatSecret AU) is 251 kcal per 125 g = 201 kcal / 100 g. Ours is ~246 kcal / 100 g (≈ 1550 g of finished jaffles), about 22 % higher because of the butter on every slice and full-fat mince and cheese. Each jaffle is ~475 kcal.
